description: This file defines the 'LoanRescheduleRequest' entity class, which models a request to reschedule a loan within the system. It includes fields for status, dates, user information, and relationships to other domain entities, as well as methods for managing the request state and related variations.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleRequest
classes.description: Entity representing a request to reschedule a loan, including status, related user info, and associated variations.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method for creating new LoanRescheduleRequest instances.

methods.name: getLoan
methods.description: Returns the associated Loan object.

methods.name: getStatusEnum
methods.description: Returns the status code of the reschedule request.

methods.name: getRescheduleFromInstallment
methods.description: Returns the installment number from which rescheduling starts.

methods.name: getRescheduleFromDate
methods.description: Returns the date from which rescheduling starts.

methods.name: getRescheduleReasonCodeValue
methods.description: Returns the code value representing the reason for rescheduling.

methods.name: getRescheduleReasonComment
methods.description: Returns the comment provided for the reschedule reason.

methods.name: getSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the date the request was submitted.

methods.name: getSubmittedByUser
methods.description: Returns the user who submitted the request.

methods.name: getApprovedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the date the request was approved.

methods.name: getApprovedByUser
methods.description: Returns the user who approved the request.

methods.name: getRejectedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the date the request was rejected.

methods.name: getRecalculateInterest
methods.description: Indicates whether interest should be recalculated.

methods.name: getRejectedByUser
methods.description: Returns the user who rejected the request.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sets the request status to approved, along with approver info.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Sets the request status to rejected, along with rejecter info.

methods.name: updateLoanRescheduleRequestToTermVariationMappings
methods.description: Adds variations to the request's related variations set.

methods.name: getLoanRescheduleRequestToTermVariationMappings
methods.description: Retrieves the set of related variation mappings.

methods.name: getInterestRateFromInstallmentTermVariationIfExists
methods.description: Returns the interest rate variation if it exists among the linked variations.

methods.name: getDueDateTermVariationIfExists
methods.description: Returns the due date variation if it exists among the linked variations.
